Container.Name: cursor-worker
Container.Overview: Always-on Cursor My Machines worker. Agent loop runs in Cursor cloud; tools run in this container over outbound HTTPS only (no ports). Create dirs /mnt/user/appdata/cursor-worker/repo and .../config before first start. Use a personal Cursor API key (Dashboard → API Keys), not a team/service key.

Config.Name: Host Path repo
Config.Description: Git checkout the worker operates on (ai-job-search, etc.)

Config.Name: Host Path config
Config.Description: Optional token file path: mount/.../config/token (chmod 600). Leave CURSOR_API_KEY empty if using the file.

Config.Name: CURSOR_API_KEY
Config.Description: Personal Cursor user API key (Dashboard → API Keys). Leave blank if using config/token file.

Config.Name: WORKER_NAME
Config.Description: Name shown under My Machines in Cursor

Config.Name: REPO_URL
Config.Description: Optional: git remote to clone into /workspace/repo on first start if empty

Config.Name: REPO_BRANCH
Config.Description: Optional branch to checkout after clone/fetch

Config.Name: IDLE_RELEASE_TIMEOUT
Config.Description: Seconds before idle worker exits; 0 = stay connected
